author: GoPro
description:
This is GoPro Family Member and Product Fellow @abekislevitz' MISSION 1 PRO ILS camera roll.

See how he put MISSION 1 PRO ILS to the test over the past six months—from the streets of Tokyo to skiing, travel across the Nordics, and everywhere in between. This cinematic 4K reel is a collection of some of his favorite moments captured while exploring what’s possible with GoPro MISSION 1 PRO ILS.

For the adventures and activities where size, space, and weight matter, carrying a full-size camera gear kit isn't always practical. MISSION 1 PRO ILS brings cinematic creativity into a compact, lightweight setup that makes it easier to bring a camera along for the ride. Capable of stunning 8K60, 4K240, and 1080p960, there's no other camera on the market like it—a class of its own.
